body.title: Conventions and quality strategies
body.summary: DimensionStrategy for conventions (per-module idiom notes and module adjudication with today's too-few-examples rule) and quality (within-part MAP, one-line descriptions, COMPARE, pair judgement through the joint-fit chain).
acceptanceChecks: A module idiom spread over parts is judged on all its examples.
Duplicated logic in symbols in different parts, including two near-budget summaries, is reported with counterpartRef.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'conventions judges a module idiom on examples from every part'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'quality reports duplication between symbols in different parts with counterpartRef'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'two duplicate symbols whose summaries fit only one at a time are judged in two directions against digests'
